# AgentKeep

> Wallet-scoped memory, fetch, receipts, trust, and human approval for AI agents. No signup and no API key. Pay each call with x402 USDC on Algorand Mainnet through GoPlausible.
>
> Website: https://agentkeep.online
> API: https://api.agentkeep.online
> Live prices and payment requirements: https://api.agentkeep.online/.well-known/x402

## Purpose

Give an agent a place to remember a value for the wallet that paid, fetch text from a public URL, check a URL before paying it, export what that wallet spent, and pause for a human approve or deny email.

## Do not use this for

Web search, company enrichment, chat, or image generation.

## How to pay

1. Call a path on https://api.agentkeep.online. No payment returns HTTP 402 and header PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
2. Pay the advertised Algorand Mainnet USDC amount (ASA 31566704). Facilitator: https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz. The facilitator pays the network fee.
3. Retry the same request with header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
4. Keep header X-AgentKeep-Session for 15 minutes and use it on GET /v1/memory/{key} and GET /v1/budget.
